text_en: Welcome those who are weak in faith, but not for the purpose of quarreling over opinions.
text_cn: 对信德软弱的人，你们该容纳，不要为意见而争论。

text_en: Some believe in eating anything, while the weak eat only vegetables.
text_cn: 有人以为什么都可吃，但那软弱的人只吃蔬菜。

text_en: Those who eat must not despise those who abstain, and those who abstain must not pass judgment on those who eat; for God has welcomed them.
text_cn: 那吃的，不要轻视不吃的；不吃的，也不要判断吃的，因为天主已接纳了他。

text_en: Who are you to pass judgment on servants of another? It is before their own lord that they stand or fall. And they will be upheld, for the Lord is able to make them stand.
text_cn: 你是谁，你竟敢判断别人的家仆？他或站立，或跌倒，都由他自己的主人管；但他必站得住，因为主能够使他站得住。

text_en: Some judge one day to be better than another, while others judge all days to be alike. Let all be fully convinced in their own minds.
text_cn: 有人以为这日比那日强，但也有人以为日日都一样；各人对自己的心思应坚信不疑才好！

text_en: Those who observe the day, observe it in honor of the Lord. Also those who eat, eat in honor of the Lord, since they give thanks to God; while those who abstain, abstain in honor of the Lord and give thanks to God.
text_cn: 那遵守日子的，是为主而遵守；那吃的，是为主而吃，因为他感谢天主；那不吃的，也是为主而不吃，他也感谢天主。

text_en: We do not live to ourselves, and we do not die to ourselves.
text_cn: 因为我们中没有一人是为自己而生的，也没有一人是为自己而死的；

text_en: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord; so then, whether we live or whether we die, we are the Lord’s.
text_cn: 因为我们或者生，是为主而生，或者死，是为主而死；所以我们或生或死，都是属于主。

text_en: For to this end Christ died and lived again, so that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
text_cn: 因为基督死而复生了，正是为作生者和死者的主。

text_en: Why do you pass judgment on your brother or sister? Or you, why do you despise your brother or sister? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.
text_cn: 你为什么判断你的弟兄？或者，你为什么轻视你的弟兄？我们众人都要站在天主的审判台前，

text_en: For it is written, “As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall give praise to God. ”
text_cn: 因为经上记载说：“我指着我自己起誓──上主的誓语：众膝都要向我跪拜，众舌都要赞颂天主。”

text_en: So then, each of us will be accountable to God.
text_cn: 这样看起来，我们每人都要向天主交自己的账。

text_en: Let us therefore no longer pass judgment on one another, but resolve instead never to put a stumbling block or hindrance in the way of another.
text_cn: 因此，我们不可再彼此判断了，反之，你们应拿定主意：总不可使弟兄失足或跌倒。

text_en: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; but it is unclean for anyone who thinks it unclean.
text_cn: 在耶稣基督内，我知道，并深信：没有什么本身是不洁的；除非有人想什么是不洁的，那东西为他才是不洁的。

text_en: If your brother or sister is being injured by what you eat, you are no longer walking in love. Do not let what you eat cause the ruin of one for whom Christ died.
text_cn: 如果你因着食物使你的兄弟心乱，你便不是按照爱德行事。基督为他死了，你不可因着你的食物使他丧亡，

text_en: So do not let your good be spoken of as evil.
text_cn: 所以你们不可使你们的优点受到诽谤。

text_en: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 其实，天主的国并不在于吃喝，而在于义德、平安以及在圣神内的喜乐；

text_en: The one who thus serves Christ is acceptable to God and has human approval.
text_cn: 凡是按这原则事奉基督的，才为天主所喜悦，为众人所称许；

text_en: Let us then pursue what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding.
text_cn: 所以我们该追求平安的事，以及彼此建立的事，

text_en: Do not, for the sake of food, destroy the work of God. Everything is indeed clean, but it is wrong for you to make others fall by what you eat;
text_cn: 不可为了食物的原故，而摧毁天主的工程。一切固然都是洁净的，但若人吃了，能使人失足，这为他便是恶事了。

text_en: it is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that makes your brother or sister stumble.
text_cn: 更好是不吃肉，不喝酒，不作什么能使你的弟兄跌倒的事。

text_en: The faith that you have, have as your own conviction before God. Blessed are those who have no reason to condemn themselves because of what they approve.
text_cn: 你有信心，就在天主前为你自己保有吧！那在自己认为可行的事上，问心无愧，才是有福的。

text_en: But those who have doubts are condemned if they eat, because they do not act from faith; for whatever does not proceed from faith is sin.
text_cn: 但谁若怀着疑心吃了，便被判有罪，因为这不是出于信心做的：凡不出于信心做的，就是罪。
